_comment: Web integration-suite baseline (item 1 slice s3d, owner decision 2026-09-10). Shrink-only allowlist of test FILES (under web/tests/integration/**) that are known to fail in CI (github-hosted Ubuntu runner, postgres:16 + redis:7-alpine services, journal replay via `drizzle-kit migrate`) — never derived from a local run: through the SSH tunnel locally 40/44 files fail, in CI 26/44 fail, and only the CI result is the baseline the gate runs against. A file's mere presence here does NOT mean it is expected to fail forever — the release cut (owner decision 2026-09-10) requires this list EMPTY. NEVER add a new entry to grandfather a newly-broken file — fix it instead, or if it is a genuinely pre-existing known failure being formally captured for the first time, add it only with the CI run URL that proved it failing. Regenerate ONLY when REMOVING entries: `node scripts/check-web-integration-baseline.mjs --report=<vitest-json-report> --update`, run against a report from the file(s) actually removed no longer failing, and commit the shrink. This gate runs ONLY inside .github/workflows/ci.yml, which is workflow_dispatch-only (billing reasons) - it does NOT run automatically on a PR and does NOT block a merge by itself; enforcement before a web-touching merge is procedural (contract clause 8: dispatch ci.yml on the branch and wait for success). Do not read a green PR as proof this gate ran.
